info.name: Ch33 Capstone: Practice API Regression Suite
info.description:
# Practice API Regression Suite

The capstone suite from Chapter 33. It tests users, products, login, orders, negative cases, security rules and response contracts of the QAMadeEasy practice API.

**Before you run:** start the practice API (`node server.js`) and select the environment *Practice API - Local*.

**Run order:** Setup > Users > Products > Auth > Orders > Negative > Security > Contract > Teardown. Every run creates its own user, product and order and removes them in Teardown.

**Full run with an HTML report:**

`newman run collections/ch33-capstone.postman_collection.json -e collections/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/capstone-report.html`

**Data-driven negative orders:** see the folder *Order validation (data-driven)*.
